messages:
ria: spotted a few tenants with negative cache savings on the dashboard after last night's rollout :confused:
omar: which tenants? timeframe?
mike: t-721 and t-884, window 2026-03-20 00:00-06:00. looks like backfill + live prefetch both counted
ria: repro: rollup batch backfill-20260320 produced duplicate credits with same request_signature
ods-bot: job "billing-rollup" executed backfill-20260320 at 02:14 UTC (status: success)
dara: short-term: dedupe credits by (origin_id, request_signature) within 24h in rollup. longer-term: canonicalize credit lineage
omar: UX ask: add a small "why negative" row in the per-tenant card showing top credit events and a counterfactual toggle to hide prefetch credits
mike: API sketch: GET /internal/v1/cost-preview?tenant=t-721&detail=provenance&counterfactual=prefetch -> numeric fields + provenance array (top N)
ria: make provenance opt-in (?detail=provenance) and limit to top 8 + "others" to keep payloads small
dara: i'll open the rollup hotfix PR now and mark urgent
omar: canary plan: deploy hotfix to canary-1 with debug for 1h, validate t-721/t-884, then promote
ria: draft support blurb: "Duplicate prefetch credits from a backfill affected displayed cache-saving numbers; billing unaffected. Fix deployed."
ods-bot: PR #8310 opened by dara (ci: pending)
mike: thanks — will monitor dashboard and post screenshots if negatives persist :thumbsup:
